name: Chiamour
source:
You're lost in the woods, when you encounter a magical book that needs your help to finish its spell. Upon finding a new reader, Chiamour feels the stirrings of a familiar soul.

She asks you questions to finish spell recipes and shares snippets of diary entries throughout history to determine where you stand. 

[From [url=https://littlemissleestories.itch.io/chiamour]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你遇到一本需要你帮助才能完成咒语的魔法书时，你在树林里迷了路。找到新读者后，奇阿穆尔感受到了熟悉的灵魂的激动。

她会问你一些问题来完成咒语配方，并分享整个历史中的日记片段，以确定你的立场。

[来自[url=https://littlemissleestories.itch.io/chiamour]itch.io[/url]]
